row.evidence: MyCase's pricing page lists Basic ($50), Pro ($100) and Advanced ($130) per user/month with no SSO or provisioning feature, and its help centre has no SSO, SAML or SCIM article; users log in with email, password and mandatory MFA.
row.notes: New row (8am MyCase, legal practice management). No SAML/OIDC SSO and no SCIM at any tier: searched the pricing page, security pages, all 590 help-centre articles, the Stoplight API reference and the Okta catalogue (no app). Users are added in the UI (single or bulk form) and deactivated, not deleted; deactivated users stop being billed. The Open API is Advanced-only (credentials issued by support) and exposes read-only Staff endpoints, so api_tax is true. Status none by absence, medium confidence.

fallbacks.notes: Users sign in with MyCase email and password plus mandatory MFA; admins add users one at a time or with the in-app Add Bulk Users form (name, email, user type). jit false: no SSO exists to create users on sign-in.
